# 釋迦如來成道記註

**ID:** X1509
**Volume:** X75
**Category:** 史傳部類
**Original Category:** 史傳部／釋迦傳
**Byline:** 唐 道誠註
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 618–907
**Juans:** 2
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X1509

## Contributors
- 道誠 (A001542)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-juan annotated commentary on [王勃](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E5%8B%83)'s short hagiography *Shìjiā Rúlái chéngdào jì* ([KR6r0027](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0027)), composed by the Sòng monk [道誠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E8%AA%A0) (Dàochéng) and dated by his colophon to 1019 (Sòng *Tiānxǐ* 天禧 3). The catalog meta classifies this entry under the Táng dynasty by association with the parent text; the actual composition is Northern Sòng. [道誠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E8%AA%A0) supplies, for each phrase of [王勃](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E5%8B%83)'s dense parallel-prose text, the underlying scriptural reference together with an explanatory paraphrase, thereby making the text accessible to readers without a thorough scriptural background.

**Abstract**

[道誠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E8%AA%A0) is best known for his other compilation, the *Shìshì yàolǎn* 釋氏要覽 ([KR6m0029](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6m/KR6m0029)) of 1019 — a major Buddhist encyclopaedic handbook — and the present commentary belongs to the same year and to the same broader project of making Buddhist learning accessible to a wider readership. Each segment of [王勃](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E5%8B%83)'s prose is reproduced in the commentary, followed by [道誠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E8%AA%A0)'s annotations identifying the source sūtra (the *Buddhacarita*, *Lalitavistara*, etc.) and clarifying the technical Buddhist allusions.

The 1019 dating is given in the colophon and is secure. The combination of [王勃](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E5%8B%83)'s elegant Táng *piánwén* with [道誠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E8%AA%A0)'s Sòng-period scriptural commentary made the *Shìjiā Rúlái chéngdào jì* one of the most readable handbooks on the Buddha's life for Sòng-period educated readers, and the annotated edition was reprinted in the Jiāxīngzàng 嘉興藏 of the late Míng.
